title: FIND returns BLANK when asked to and the case does not match

source.quote: If not found, FIND returns Blank. FIND is case-sensitive.
source.supports: the documented example passes BLANK () as the NotFoundValue and gets blank where "Bike" is absent

derivation: "bike shop" has no "Bike" with a capital B, so the NotFoundValue, BLANK, is returned.
notes: The type of the all-BLANK column is not asserted.
